manifesto.text: We don't sell hours. We design, build and ship things that work — our own products first, and now and then one with the right partner.

work.label: 01 / What we build
work.title: What we build.
work.intro: Real products, built in-house. Each one started as an idea and had to survive contact with reality.

e1758.pitch: It's 5:58 PM. The bus leaves at 6:00. Get from your desk to the exit before a manager hands you <q>one more quick task</q>.
e1758.body: A third-person stealth comedy about the most dangerous two minutes of the workday. Managers patrol, coworkers snitch, the elevator breaks down.
e1758.body2: We designed and built it end to end — gameplay, AI, adaptive music, localization and a build pipeline for every platform — and we're getting it ready for Steam.
e1758.cap1: 5:58 PM, still at your desk. Your coworker has opinions.
e1758.cap2: The elevator is out. A trash can makes a decent plant.

cotaria.kicker: SaaS · Business platform · MVP in build
cotaria.pitch: Hairy financial rules, turned into software that does the math.
cotaria.body: Cotaria runs consórcio groups — Brazil's pooled-credit model, where members pay into a shared fund and receive credit through monthly draws and bids.
cotaria.body2: Installments, late fees, monetary correction, draws, bids, exclusions, refunds, group closing: every rule written down, numbered, tested and enforced by the system, with a full audit trail.
cotaria.cap: System map. Screens when it ships — for now, the engine.
cotaria.spec_apps_v: Back office, admin console, member portal
cotaria.spec_quality_v: Numbered spec, traced tests, end-to-end suite

about.label: 03 / About
about.title: Built by experience. Driven by curiosity.
about.p1: MAEDODEAM was founded by Roger Maedo, a software engineer with about twenty years of building systems that run in production.
about.p2: Most of that time went into the hard, invisible parts: backends, architecture, integrations, distributed and enterprise systems — and leading the engineering behind them.
about.p3: MAEDODEAM is where that experience gets to build things of its own: independent products, games, experiments, and collaborations on problems that are actually interesting.
about.p4: Small on purpose. The person you talk to is the person who builds.

contact.label: 04 / Let's talk
contact.title: Let's build something interesting.
contact.q4: Want to collaborate, invest or create something together?
contact.text: We're open to product partnerships, joint ventures, new businesses, SaaS, games and experiments — and, for the right idea, a stake in something new. Tell us what you're building.
